name: dumbbell floor wiper
description: Lying on your back with a dumbbell held overhead, you swing your legs side to side like a wiper. It challenges the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back to the middle.
Repeat to the other side, keeping your shoulders flat.
